# PT Infinix Delapan Teknologi Nusantara (IDTN)

> PT Infinix Delapan Teknologi Nusantara (IDTN) is an integrated telecommunications solutions provider specializing in Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM) optical transmission technology and carrier-grade transport infrastructure in Indonesia. Official technology partner of T8 Systems (https://t8.ru/en/).

## Official Website & Contacts
- Website: https://idtn.co.id/
- Location: Fatmawati City Center, Ruko Soho Botany Garden Crystal No. 18, Jl. Fatmawati Raya, Cilandak Barat, Jakarta Selatan 12430, Indonesia
- Email: info@idtn.co.id
- Phone: +62 21 3192 8888
- WhatsApp: +62 811 8888 8888

## Key Optical Transport Metrics
- Geographic Footprint: 8,514.22 km spanning from Sabang to Merauke across the Indonesian archipelago.
- Maximum Speed per Wavelength (Lambda): 800 Gbps per optical channel.
- Maximum Chassis Transmission Capacity: Up to 38.4 Tbps per fiber pair across C+L spectral bands.
- Long-Haul Reach: Over 1,500 km unrepeatered transmission without electrical regeneration.
- Protection Switching: 1+1 Optical Line Protection (OLP) with sub-50ms automatic failover.

## Core Hardware Portfolio (T8 Volga I Platform)
1. DWDM System Volga I Telecom (1U, 3U, 6U, 10U Modular Chassis):
   Engineered for national long-haul backbone networks and regional metro rings. Supports 100G, 200G, 400G, and 800G linecards, Raman/EDFA amplifiers, and CDC-F ROADM.
2. DWDM System Volga I DCI (1U / 2U Compact Modular):
   Purpose-built for hyperscale data center interconnection with minimal latency, low power consumption, and front-to-back server rack airflow.
3. DWDM System DCI V2 (6.4 Tbps per 2U):
   Next-generation ultra-dense appliance providing 6.4 Tbps bidirectional throughput per 2U unit with wire-speed Layer 1 AES-256 physical encryption.
4. OTDR Monitoring System Ramenka:
   Automatic 24/7 in-service optical line monitoring operating at 1625nm with +/- 1 meter fault diagnostic accuracy without disrupting live traffic.
5. NMS Titan & Fractal Management:
   Centralized network management and SDN orchestration suite with RESTCONF, NETCONF/YANG, and SNMP integration.

## Two Core Business Pillars
1. DWDM Equipment Developer: Adapting world-class optical transport hardware to meet Indonesian SDPPI Kominfo regulatory standards and archipelagic topology.
2. DWDM Infrastructure Service Provider: Turnkey optical route survey, link design, carrier-grade hardware supply, installation, commissioning, 24/7 preventive maintenance, and engineering training.
